rationale: Newer official 2026-11-14 01:15 PM ET injury report was discovered during additional pre-tip source review: Cleveland Evan Mobley confirmed OUT; Jarrett Allen, Donovan Mitchell, James Harden QUESTIONABLE; Sam Merrill OUT. This substantially weakens baseline confidence in Cleveland's frontcourt and on-ball creation against Dallas, whose season accepted defense is stronger (DRtg 109.28 vs CLE 113.11). However Q does not mean OUT. Dallas Dereck Lively II is OUT and Max Christie DOUBTFUL; if multiple Cleveland questionable creators play, the model's Cleveland favorite remains plausible. Lean DAL is a cautious qualitative contrary opinion, not a changed numerical model forecast.
counterargument: Mitchell, Harden and Allen are QUESTIONABLE and could all play; Dallas is also missing Lively, and Cleveland retains home court. Sample size ~12-13 games is small. LOW confidence only.
supersedes_only: Prior DAL@CLE independent qualitative ANALYST_LEAN null; other four qualitative leans unchanged

primary_evidence.change: Cleveland changed from NOT YET SUBMITTED in 13:00 ET report to detailed player statuses in 13:15 ET report; both documents existed before initial lock. Missing check acknowledged.

interpretation_rule: For postgame analyst performance, use latest immutable pre-tip analyst opinion, identify this revision explicitly; retain earlier record for audit.
